notes.title: Rogue Conflict, Update III
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993717/ae00a6c368288e25ad44851d41fbd71e2762a2b9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Guess who's back![/b] [/p][p]After taking a long break from working on any RC related content, I am happy to announce that I got some new goodies for you all, in the form of some new Quality of life features, bug fixes and some other minor improvements.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Features:[/h2][p][b]Combat preview window:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993717/c1710b2872d184a1e67e1dcc848afd7e764ff85e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The biggest new feature, that I have spent the most time working on during this updates development is this new "combat preview window" as I like to call it.[/p][p][/p][p]This window will show up when you hover over a enemy unit, and its purpose is to give you a more detailed overview of what will go down when you attack an enemy.[/p][p][/p][p]I know there have been people asking for something like this for a while, and I myself have also for a long time wanted to add something like this to the game, as I've always felt that the numbers that pop up on top of a enemy unit when you target them, just isn't enough information, especially for new players I can imagine it can be very frustrating when you are trying to learn the ropes of the game. So hopefully this will alleviate the learning curve a bit, which I still believe is one of the biggest issues with the game.[/p][p][/p][p]And if you want to read more in detail what kind of information the combat preview window entails, then you can do so in the in-game manual under the "Combat" entry.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Unit Rank Icons:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993717/f24d6b50c9f91c2408e6ff47ae4ca01f5d8abfb4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The next quality of life feature in this update, are these "unit rank icons".[/p][p][/p][p]This one is also one that I have for a long time wanted to add to the game myself, and have gotten requests to put something similar in the game.[/p][p][/p][p]The purpose of these "icons" or "numbers" is to tell you what rank the unit is simply by looking at it and not needing to click on it, which will hopefully make it a bit easier when you manage your units.[/p][p][/p][p]But honestly, I gotta say that I am not completely satisfied with the results, as you still can't tell exactly what type of upgrades the unit is carrying without clicking on it. [/p][p][/p][p]But hopefully this will do for now.[/p][p][/p][p]Also, if these two new features bother you, and you find them to be in the way. Then I added the option to turn them off in the settings window:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993717/18b6e66f0a0beba9360e42d99741dfbbd21c203d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Undo Purchase option:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993717/2b7c45b37f74dd8a89276ee46fc2d1d8344efd99.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Finally, I added this undo purchase option. So that if you accidentally purchase a unit or upgrade in the Request Reinforcements menu. Then you can return it and get all you requisition points back.[/p][p][/p][h2]Other Improvements and Changes:[/h2][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed bug where the game would sometimes freeze during the enemy turn when the enemy was trying to "coordinate" an attack with too many units at once.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the game would sometimes freeze during the enemies turn if an enemy unit would get "ambushed" by a player unit that it didn't have vision on[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the blue "highlight" wouldn't show up on a minefields tile when using the "remove minefield" action[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where minefields would sometimes go "invisible" during the enemies turn[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where some tooltips would be partly obscured by the cursor[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the LRRP units camouflage expert upgrade would sometimes "duplicate"[/p][/*][/list][p]Special shout out to Demonic emperor on Discord for helping me with the 2 bugs on the top of the list. Because they are bugs that I believe have been irking players for a long time, so it felt good to finally put them to rest.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Other Minor Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated and added tooltips in various places[/p][/*][*][p]Increased price for Heavy Tanks by 25 RP (still feel they are very op)[/p][/*][*][p]Added backgrounds to texts in various places, that was previously a bit hard to read[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Other News:[/h2][p]Lastly I would like to let you all know why I decided to release this updated, and why I haven't released any during the summer.[/p][p][/p][p]The main reason being that I am in the middle of a big move right now, which has been taking up a lot of my time and energy during this summer. And the time that I have had to put down on game development, has been spent on my next game rather than new content for RC.[/p][p][/p][p]The reason for that being as I've mentioned on the RC's steam forum and Discord, is that because of the games poor sales I feel like I haven't been able to justify it to myself to put down the time on it.[/p][p][/p][p]And even though the sales situation hasn't changed, I've had a bit of a change of mind on the subject. For one, I still have faith in the game and that it will be able to sell and pick up more sales in the future.[/p][p]But also, now that I have had time to distance myself from the game during the summer, I have actually started missing working on the game, and my mind has been flooding with new ideas for it, which I have been desiring to implement.[/p][p][/p][p]Which brings me to the topic of the future of RC, which is still very unclear, but I am more and more wanting to work on a bigger update for the game, potentially in the form of new DLC.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Potential Future DLC:[/b][/p][p]Like I said earlier, ever since the launch of RC and once I had the time to distance myself from the project, my mind has started to come up with new ideas and improvements for the game.[/p][p]Which I was originally planning on saving for a RC 2, but considering how far off something like that would be, I've been more and more considering putting those ideas into a DLC for the game instead.[/p][p][/p][p]One of the main points of a DLC would be to address certain aspects of the game that I've never been fully content with and that I always felt were quite uninspired. [/p][p]And also of course to add bunch of new cool units and stuff like that. [/p][p][/p][p]So let me know if you guys think that is a good idea and something you would be interested in.[/p][p]And also if you have any requests of what you would like to see in such an "expansion", then feel free to let me know, as I am always very grateful for any and all feedback I can get.[/p][p][/p][p]Until next time, Regards, Frans Wikman[/p]

tags.feature: The biggest new feature, that I have spent the most time working on during this updates development is this new "combat preview window" as I like to call it.
This window will show up when you hover over a enemy unit, and its purpose is to give you a more detailed overview of what will go down when you attack an enemy.
The next quality of life feature in this update, are these "unit rank icons".

The purpose of these "icons" or "numbers" is to tell you what rank the unit is simply by looking at it and not needing to click on it, which will hopefully make it a bit easier when you manage your units.
Finally, I added this undo purchase option. So that if you accidentally purchase a unit or upgrade in the Request Reinforcements menu. Then you can return it and get all you requisition points back.

tags.bug: Fixed bug where the game would sometimes freeze during the enemy turn when the enemy was trying to "coordinate" an attack with too many units at once.
Fixed bug where the game would sometimes freeze during the enemies turn if an enemy unit would get "ambushed" by a player unit that it didn't have vision on
Fixed bug where the blue "highlight" wouldn't show up on a minefields tile when using the "remove minefield" action
Fixed bug where minefields would sometimes go "invisible" during the enemies turn
Fixed bug where some tooltips would be partly obscured by the cursor
Fixed bug where the LRRP units camouflage expert upgrade would sometimes "duplicate"

tags.balance_change: Increased price for Heavy Tanks by 25 RP (still feel they are very op)

notes.title: Rogue Conflict, Update I
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993717/2185be688b5cfc212f3c91f8c47ed2befd3d75c9.png[/img]

Welcome everybody to the first ever Rogue Conflict update.

The big new feature alongside all the regular tweaks and bug fixes in this update, are the new difficulty options. 
You can now choose between "easy" and "standard" difficulty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993717/b22b2563f3e00789b882a8416905a433b1521cec.png[/img]

The reason for adding these new difficulty options is because after reading all the feedback I've gotten since launch, the main complaint seems to be the game's difficulty.

And the reason I went with a new easier difficulty option rather than tweaking the standard difficulty of the game, is because generally speaking I'm pretty happy with the level of difficulty and balance of the game, as I've always intended for the game to be challenging and not something that you can just blow through on your first try.

But in the same time, I do realize how frustrating it can be to spend several hours trying to get to grips with the fundamentals of the game, and in the end of it have no sign of progress to show for it, and no new armies unlocked to play with.
So I hope this new difficulty option will help ease some of that frustration, and if you are new to the game then I recommend starting out on the easy difficulty, and then switch to standard once you feel like you've gotten the hang of things.

The way the new easy difficulty works, is that if you beat the campaign on the easier difficulty you will still get a medal for your accomplishment, but it will be a separate medal from the one you receive on the standard difficulty.
This new medal is worth just as much as the old one when it comes to unlocking new armies, the only difference being that certain achievements won't be available.

If you want to know excactly what type of effect the Easy difficulty option has on the campaign, then you can read about it in the in-game manual, under the "Choose your army" entry.

Last thing I will say about the general difficulty of the game is, that I'm not necessarily completely against tweaking the balance and difficulty of the standard mode.
But I just want to be careful when doing, so I don't make any rash decisions that I will later regret.
And I hope instead that these new difficulty options will at least for now deal with people's concerns.


[h1]Other Changes To The Game:[/h1]

[b]Quality of Life Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Air Unit list will no longer close at the end of the turn if you have it open.
[*] If you select an enemy unit you can now see all its possible movement locations, as seen in the image below
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993717/cc5b7c049be8cfd88744014c04f0081caced720e.jpg[/img]
[*] When ending your turn, the game will now also check if you have any unused Aircraft units.
[*] You can now put your aircraft units to rest and permanently rest.
[*] Change The coloring of the number above all of the units that represents their morale and strength, So that the number now turns red when the unit's morale is 20 or lower, rather than 24 or lower.
This change was made to better help the player see which units are available for combat as 20 or lower is the morale threshold for when units can't engage in combat anymore.
[*] The morale and strength "bars" that show up in the Ui at the bottom of the screen when selecting a unit, now has a number on them showing you the unit's excact current morale and strength.
This is so you no longer need to hover over the bars and wait for the tooltip to find out the exact number.
[/list]

[b]Typos[/b]
Fixed a bunch of typos in these places:
[list]
[*] Competitive upgrade in the traits window
[*] Resilient upgrade in couple of different places
[*] Armored personnel carrier in the unit statistics window
[*] Combat Drills upgrade was spelled as ambush specialist in certain instances
[*] The rewards screen at the end of each mission, was missing the "RP" label in certain places
[*] Missing title for the Anti-Air unit's emergency reinforcements upgrade
[*] The "No challenge too great achievement" was misspelled
[/list]


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where the victory cinematic sometimes wouldn't load
[*] Fixed bug where unit actions that allow you to remove fog of war (such as recon drone or recon mission) would remove fog of war on tiles outside of the map boundaries
[*] Fixed bug where certain tiles would show as upside down in the selection window when clicking on them
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the amount of enemies you have to destroy in the objective type where you have to destroy a certain amount of enemies, to 25 from 30, if it is the third mission
[*] Changed movement points of heavy tanks from 6 to 5
[*] Changed value of heavy tanks from 400 to 425
These 2 changes to the Heavy Tank I made because I feel like the heavy tanks have become a bit too powerful, way more so than I initially intended
[/list]

[b]Finals Words:[/b]
I would like to close this update by thanking everyone that has played Rogue Conflict and posted feedback on the games forums and Discord.

I read through them daily and I truly appreciate any and all feedback, I was even considering posting the usernames of the people who's ideas I implemented in this news post.
But I wasn't sure if people wanted their usernames plastered all over this news post or not. But you know who you are, and I want you to know that I am thankful for all the support.
